# Grid

## Grid family

The layout grid: Grid holds Columns (CSS-grid form) or Rows (flexbox
form); Row and Column read the family context for the gutter halves and
the breakpoint the laid-out width names.

### Decisions

Samples express columns through the `columns` composition prop (as
TileGroup's `items`, D21a): samples cannot carry element children. `span:
0` draws nothing, as upstream's `col-span-0`. Row and Column carry the
`requires_parent` flag: a Row draws only inside a Grid and a Column only
inside a Grid or Row - the family context the Grid provides carries the
gutter halves and the breakpoint. Column also carries `no_reference`:
upstream's bare `.cds--col` box is measured through the Grid and Row
references instead.

### U2 repair (upstream quoted)

The grid takes its container's width, `breakpoint.max` only caps it
(`.cds--css-grid` / `.cds--grid` inline-size 100%). A Column's text child
takes `color.text_primary`, as upstream's bare div inherits the body color
(the dark perceptual 2.5% was black text). The flexbox Row pulls back by half
the regular gutter in every grid kind; condensed and narrow change only the
columns' padding (probe `Row.json`: rows margin-left -16 in all states). The
Row reference draws the probe's FlexGrid itself and the sample's Grid wrapper
is `reference: false` (upstream's `Grid` is the CSS grid).

### Platform

`platform.support` is `both`.

## Column

Column is one cell of the layout grid, spanning a number of the breakpoint's columns with the gutter halves the family context carries; it must be composed inside Grid or Row, with no upstream visual reference of its own - it is measured through the Grid and Row samples.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `none` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent; `no_reference` - no upstream visual reference; gates are structural, accessibility and cross-template |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `node` | no | The column's content. |
| `sm` | `one` | no | The span at the sm breakpoint: a count, a `n%` string, `true` for auto, or `{ span, offset }`. |
| `md` | `one` | no | The span at the md breakpoint. |
| `lg` | `one` | no | The span at the lg breakpoint. |
| `xlg` | `one` | no | The span at the xlg breakpoint. |
| `max` | `one` | no | The span at the max breakpoint. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the column. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `columns` | `grid.columns_lg` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"children":"Column"}` |

## Grid

Grid is the layout grid that holds rows of columns sized per breakpoint.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | none |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `array` | no | Composition prop: the columns as data (samples cannot carry element children); each becomes a Column. |
| `children` | `node` | no | The Columns (CSS-grid mode) or Rows (flexbox mode) to lay out. |
| `condensed` | `boolean` | no | The one-pixel gutter. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | no | The grid spans the whole width; no max. |
| `narrow` | `boolean` | no | The 16px gutter. |
| `withRowGap` | `boolean` | no | A gutter-height gap between lines / rows. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the grid. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `columns` | `grid.columns_lg` |
| `gutter` | `grid.gutter` |
| `gutterCondensed` | `grid.gutter_condensed` |
| `gutterNarrow` | `grid.gutter_narrow` |
| `margin` | `grid.margin_lg` |
| `bpSm` | `breakpoint.sm` |
| `bpMd` | `breakpoint.md` |
| `bpLg` | `breakpoint.lg` |
| `bpXlg` | `breakpoint.xlg` |
| `maxWidth` | `breakpoint.max` |

### States (sample.js)

| State | Props |
|---|---|
| default | `{"columns":[{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4}]}` |
| condensed | `{"columns":[{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4}],"condensed":true}` |
| narrow | `{"columns":[{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4}],"narrow":true}` |
| fullWidth | `{"columns":[{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4},{"children":"Column","lg":4}],"fullWidth":true}` |
| offset | `{"columns":[{"children":"Column","lg":{"offset":4,"span":4}},{"children":"Column","lg":8}]}` |
| wrap | `{"columns":[{"children":"Column","lg":8},{"children":"Column","lg":8},{"children":"Column","lg":16}]}` |
| rowGap | `{"columns":[{"children":"Column","lg":8},{"children":"Column","lg":8},{"children":"Column","lg":8},{"children":"Column","lg":8}],"withRowGap":true}` |

## Row

Row is one row of a Grid; it must be composed inside Grid.

| | |
|---|---|
| Tier | `molecule` |
| Platform | `both` |
| Reference | `render-web` (`@carbon/react`) |
| Enums | none |
| Behaviors | none |
| Flags | `requires_parent` - renders only inside its parent |

### Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `array` | no | Composition prop: the columns as data (samples cannot carry element children); each becomes a Column. |
| `children` | `node` | no | The Columns to lay out. |
| `testID` | `string` | no | Test identifier forwarded to the row. |

### Metrics

| Metric | Rule |
|---|---|
| `gutter` | `grid.gutter` |
